source_description: Provisional compatibility profile derived from the Bike Test 2 recording and the manually reviewed v5 detection result. This is NOT a physically ground-truthed wheel-revolution calibration.

geometry.assumption: one cable-tie click per spoke crossing

metrics.note: 673 is the v5 adaptive detection count from Bike Test 2. It is not an independently known spoke-strike count.

notes: TEST PROFILE ONLY. Confirmed wheel geometry is 36 spokes, but this profile is still not a physical known-revolution calibration. Geometry may be used for derived diagnostics only; it must not force detections to a multiple of 36. Replace this file with a genuine calibration_profile.json produced by src/calibrate_v2.py before participant data collection.
